newsitem.title: USA: Eagle USA Airfreight stock off 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: Eagle USA Airfreight stock off 33 pct.

text.p: The stock of Eagle USA Airfreight Inc. lost more than a third of its value Tuesday, one day after the company reported a 40 percent jump in earnings, but the results still managed to disappoint Wall Street.
Eagle plunged $10.25 at $20.25 on the Nasdaq market.

The Houston-based airfreight company said it earned $2.9 million or 16 cents a share in its fiscal second quarter ended on March 31 compared with year-earlier earnings of $2.1 million or 11 cents. Sales jumped 57 percent to $61.5 million from $39 million. While sharply higher, the earnings still fell short of analysts' consensus estimate of 17 cents.
